description.value: DRAGONfly Cafe is a beloved breakfast-and-lunch spot in Salmo, BC, known for its specialty Kicking Horse Coffee, homemade baked goods, ice cream, and a rotating display of local artists' photography on the walls. Customer testimonials single it out as an essential stop on any trip into the Kootenays. The menu spans hearty egg dishes, grilled paninis, poutine variations, and Eggs Benedict.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active café at 413 Railway Ave, Salmo, BC with phone 250.357.2867. The menu lists vegetarian dishes (VEG BREAKY PANINI, VEGGIE POUTINE, MEDITERRANEAN SCRAMBLE) and a Gluten Free Waffle, confirming dietary options. A customer testimonial references leaving with 'to-go coffee in hand,' supporting takeout. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill appears on the site.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'The Dragon Fly Café' but website branding is 'DRAGONfly CAFE' / 'Dragonfly Cafe' — may warrant OSM tag correction.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced exclusively from website and not cross-confirmed against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-reviewed café on a Kootenays touring route with a substantial menu, vegetarian and GF options, and takeout service — a clear benefit to cycle tourists passing through Salmo.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes VEG BREAKY PANINI, VEGGIE POUTINE, SPINACH/TOMATO/PESTO Eggs Benedict, MEDITERRANEAN SCRAMBLE, GREEK panini (vegetarian options), and a Gluten Free Waffle. No explicit vegan labelling found
